title: Placement decision
description: Where each new artifact goes, decided once and frozen before the plan is derived. specs/0004 R52: for every plan entry the manifest does not lock, the target path comes from a decision the pack produced, validated before use and frozen before derivation began. This artifact exists because the plan must know a new entry's path — R25 detects collisions before any write, and a collision between two new entries is the case worth catching — while R23 admits no model into the derivation. A path the manifest does not yet hold has one source, and that source is a model; making it an explicit, validated, inspectable input is what keeps the derivation model-free. R53 makes it run-scoped, the one exemption from R46's rule that a model-produced body is committed, and only while all four of its conditions hold: the run transcribes the decision into the manifest under R30, the manifest is the named committed authority, the transcription happens in the same run, and a run that ends without producing an artifact locks no path for it.

path.description: Repository-relative. Never absolute and never traversing: R52 requires validation to reject a path outside the governed repository, and a decision is also an instruction to write there.
